description: This file contains support routines for creating and manipulating pack files, including functions for printing pack headers, objects, and trailers, as well as handling specific object cases and testing object IDs.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte octal representation of a number.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints the 4-byte binary representation of a number.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Prints a pack header for a given number of objects.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Outputs the pack data for a specific object, handling special cases and deltas.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends the pack trailer to a file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes existing pack files to prepare for new pack creation.
